About

My path into AI began with medical images.

I studied Computer Engineering and then Artificial Intelligence at Shahid Beheshti University in Tehran. Working on radiotherapy planning during my master’s taught me to care about the whole path from raw data to a useful result.

In November 2023, I joined the Chair of Dependable Nano Computing at Karlsruhe Institute of Technology. I’m interested in what happens when intelligent systems leave ideal software environments and meet the constraints of physical devices.

I enjoy work that crosses disciplines and becomes something concrete, and explaining technical ideas so people from different backgrounds can work together.
